formal_statement: Active projection preserves counterexample status for projected witness.
assumptions: active support contains all payload/certificate/status dependencies
reason: Too strong without inactive-support counterexample-status locality proof.

formal_statement: If status changes under projection, the projected object is a smaller counterexample witness.
assumptions: strict active subset; projected status is still counterexample or reduced obstruction
reason: Needs smaller-counterexample fallback and status-locality theorem.

formal_statement: Active projection preserves status or reduces to a smaller counterexample witness.
assumptions: active support contains dependencies; strict measure decrease when inactive support exists
reason: Useful target but still too strong before status-locality proof closes.

formal_statement: Active projection preserves status, reduces to a smaller witness, or routes failure to a named blocker/deferred higher-support escape.
assumptions: active support notation; project-to-active semantics; status language; measure guard
reason: Selected because it is the strongest statement supported without hiding open status locality/fallback obligations.

formal_statement: Every support-growth witness has full active projection status congruence.
assumptions: arbitrary support-growth witness; complete active dependency extraction; all preservation proofs
reason: Out of scope; would incorrectly promote one operation to full operation proof.
